capability_rows.capability: transcribe recordings with a time for every word, and redo the places where the speech model looped; hear a recording in the person's files, or a link's video, into words on their own computer; read transcript and caption files (srt, vtt, txt, json, YouTube json3) into timed words and check quotes against them
read which of the person's checks apply to an AI's tool call from their check lists, wherever the session runs, and run them
run a coordination session: its purpose, mode, who may join and its offers

keep each AI session on this computer as the person's records, take the open work handed to this computer's AIs, wake their stopped sessions, and set up this computer's AI apps with the account's key, hooks and connection

listen to the microphone for a while: record it in pieces until an end time, hear each piece, name who said each turn from the prints people enrolled, and write each turn as a heard row as it is said; hear a recording another of the person's devices made the same way
let several devices share one session, such as cameras, a watch and a remote, with exactly one in charge and ignore any message that breaks the rules
plan the next training session and log workouts
score two builds of an AI's behavior on the same trap tasks from the calls each run recorded, to see which does better

turn a written video presentation plan into the recording session the camera screen runs: the teleprompter script sentence by sentence, the countdown, when to stop on silence, on the final word or on a stop phrase, and whether it may start by itself
read which browser session and account a screen in the person's browser is signed in as, and the browser's own id, for the screens that need them
